description.zh-CN: CloudTower 4.9.0 受控验收候选：物理盘 SMART 与每日历史、本地化和劣化风险；真实主机采集尚未验收。
description.en-US: CloudTower 4.9.0 controlled acceptance candidate: localized disk SMART, daily history and deterioration. Live host collection remains unverified.

compatibility.tower: CloudTower 4.9.0 controlled candidate; real SMART collection remains unverified.

releaseNotes.zh-CN: 0.1.6：明确显示磁盘采集命令范式、目标类别、新鲜主机库存参数来源及 all/custom 逐盘展开边界。用途声明不绑定固定设备路径，不增加执行命令或权限；物理盘样本及每日采集仍待真实环境测试。
releaseNotes.en-US: 0.1.6: show the disk collection template, category, fresh host inventory argument source and all/custom per-disk expansion. The declaration selects no fixed path and adds no executable operation or permission. Physical samples and daily collection await real-environment testing.

purpose.zh-CN: 读取各目标主机授权物理盘 SMART，按策略逐盘展开并保留人工审批。参数要求来自本机新鲜库存；旧v1仅原可信映射待核验，不自动扩权。命令范式：sudo -n -- /usr/sbin/smartctl --json=c --all <disk>
purpose.en-US: Read each target host's authorized physical disks under all/custom policy and administrator approval. Require fresh host inventory; legacy v1 uses configured mappings pending verification without automatic widening. Template: sudo -n -- /usr/sbin/smartctl --json=c --all <disk>
